verificationMeaning: Only fields in verifiedFacts were checked against an opened official product/catalogue page. This is not certification of a received package, ingredient safety, Kazakhstan availability, owner inventory or a batch expiry.
photoPolicy: All photo fields are null: a public manufacturer packshot is not a reuse licence. Do not hotlink or download it for ARIA without an explicit licence/permission; use labelled placeholders or owner-authorised photos.
storeDataPolicy: No price, stock, unit cost, sales history or lot date is supplied. Any later educational price/lot fixture must be created separately and labelled DEMONSTRATION, never described as market observation or real inventory.
identityPolicy: referenceId is an ARIA documentation identifier, not a manufacturer SKU or GTIN. EANs are not inferred from URL numbers. Multi-packs remain distinct from single units.
manufacturerPolicy: sourcePublisher identifies the official information publisher, not necessarily the legal manufacturer of a specific regional package. manufacturer remains null until exact pack evidence is available.
